example.title: Sea & Sun Motel: a single-storey motel with a tall pole sign

brief: An early-1970s single-storey motel: a long low block under a wide shallow roof with deep eaves, brown fascia, room windows with air-conditioners, a tall yellow pole sign with a LED board, in a dusty car park with desert hills behind. One photo (at dusk). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
